# infoblox_nsgroup_stubmember (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox NsgroupStubmember from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a NS Group Stub Member by filters
data "infoblox_nsgroup_stubmember" "get_ns_group_stubmember_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_stubmember"
  }
}

// Retrieve NS Group Stub Members using Extensible Attributes
data "infoblox_nsgroup_stubmember" "get_ns_group_stubmember_using_extensible_attributes" {
  ext_attr_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all NS Group Stub Members
data "infoblox_nsgroup_stubmember" "get_all_ns_group_stubmembers" {}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to return a more specific list of results by filtering on extensible attributes. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.
